question: This summer I will be hired as a Graduate Research Assistant. What course do I need to register for?
answers: Students supported by the university as research assistants during the summer months must register for at least three credits during the 7½-week summer session. The work must be related to the student’s degree program, and the funding amount must meet the minimum requirement. Students may register in research, thesis, pre-candidacy study, dissertation, internship, sustaining, or a regular graduate course offered in the 7½-week session.

question: I'm a doctoral student and my status has not changed to Sustaining. When will my status change to Sustaining?
answers: Once a graduate student has completed registration in all required course credits needed for the degree and all other degree requirements except submission of the thesis, dissertation, or portfolio, they must maintain matriculation in the program by registering for sustaining credits (UNIV 899 or UNIV 999).
